summary: AST route extractor for legacy web.py plugins
prompt: Read docs/SPEC.md and docs/AGENTS_SPEC.md first; they are the binding contract. Use only the project venv (.venv/bin/python, .venv/bin/pytest); do not install packages; do not modify anything under tests/ or docs/; do not touch .switch-infra/ or .native/ or any file not listed as your deliverable.
